op-75eb278d6a9fb4cf.rationale: secret-blast-radius only reads local files, environment variable names and helper command output (ps, crontab -l, git, php -v) and prints a ranked inventory without secret values. These exact invocations are offline and write nothing, so the extension adds no review finding for them. Unlisted forms stay under review, notably --osv (sends lockfile package names and versions to api.osv.dev) and --sarif-file/--runbook-file (write a report to a chosen path).
op-75eb278d6a9fb4cf.saferAlternative: Run secret-blast-radius without --osv to stay offline, and print reports to stdout instead of writing them with --sarif-file or --runbook-file.
